channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Mesmo fora do TSE, Moraes deve definir até que ponto Bolsonaro pode ser cabo eleitoral
item.description: Although not part of the TSE, Minister Alexandre de Moraes is expected to set boundaries on the synthetic use of Jair Bolsonaro's image in the 2026 campaign, as unauthorized AI-generated content may be deemed deep fake and subject to judicial sanctions. This directly impacts Flávio Bolsonaro and other PL candidates seeking to leverage Bolsonaro's image, which holds significant vote-transfer power. Bolsonaro's defense denies authorization for the convention video, raising the risk of liability for violating STF orders when using his image synthetically without consent.

item.title: Ao vivo: PSB confirma Alckmin como candidato a vice de Lula
item.description: The PSB officially confirmed Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate for re-election on Lula’s ticket during its National Convention in Brasília on Wednesday, July 29, 2026. The event, held at the Brazil 21 Events and Convention Center, was attended by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Alckmin, 73, resigned from his role as Minister of Development to run again, after over three decades in the PSDB and joining the PSB in 2022.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Compra de votos? Lula usa El Niño para distruibuir cestas básicas
item.description: The Lula government expanded its basic food basket distribution program based on the El Niño climate phenomenon, announced by Chief of Staff Miriam Belchior. The measure, unveiled in a public meeting ahead of the October elections, has been criticized as a potential vote-buying tactic using climate-related aid for political gain.

item.title: Saiba como vai funcionar o "Pix Pensão", sancionado por Lula
item.description: President Lula signed into law the so-called 'Pix Pension' measure, which establishes automatic electronic transfers of child support payments supervised by the national financial system authority. The law allows beneficiaries to request automatic monthly transfers to their account or that of their legal representative, with the payer specifying the debit account. Judges set payment terms, and banks must report compliance or failures, with potential asset blocking if funds are insufficient.

item.title: Lula sanciona leis pró-mulher, e Janja critica 'deputado que zoa' misoginia
item.description: President Lula signed the "Pix Pension" law, which establishes automatic transfer of child support payments to beneficiaries' accounts. During the ceremony at the Planalto Palace, First Lady Janja da Silva criticized lawmakers who make jokes about women victims of misogyny.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que Milei foi 'educado' e 'suave' nas críticas ao Brasil
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro said he agrees with the criticisms of Argentine President Javier Milei toward Lula's government, describing Milei's remarks as 'educated' and 'soft'. The statement was made in an interview with Argentine newspaper La Nación on Tuesday evening, October 28.

item.title: Integrantes do governo dizem que funcionários do Departamento de Estado que tiveram vistos negados planejavam encontro com Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian government denied visas to two U.S. State Department officials, Riley M. Barnes and Samuel D. Samson, after learning they planned to meet with presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro during a visit officially framed as discussing freedom of expression in the electoral context. The decision by Itamaraty was based on concerns about the visit being instrumentalized in a pre-electoral context, particularly after Bolsonaro questioned electronic voting machines and called for international observers based on false claims debunked by the TSE since 2017.

item.title: Lula reclama de corporativismo de juízes e procuradores e prega reforma de instituições
item.description: President Lula (PT) criticized the corporatism of judges and prosecutors, stating that institutional reform is necessary. He made the remarks during the ceremony sanctioning projects aimed at defending women in Brasília.

item.title: Lula concederá entrevista a podcast nesta quinta-feira (30/7)
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will grant an interview to the Inteligência Ltda. podcast this Thursday (30/7) at 6:30 p.m., streamed on YouTube. This will be his first interview since the start of party conventions and comes three days before his official re-election candidacy announcement on Sunday (2/8) in São Paulo. Lula’s campaign is reviving its podcast strategy to boost visibility, following limited appearances in this format during his term, and is evaluating his participation in televised debates, including the first showdown on Bandeirantes TV on August 23.

item.title: Defesa diz que Bolsonaro não autorizou vídeo de IA apresentado em convenção
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro told Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that he did not authorize the use of his image and voice in an AI-generated video presented at the PL convention, which confirmed his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The defense argued that, due to the STF’s suspension of visits, Bolsonaro could not have granted authorization, but emphasized the family’s trust relationship and the historical use of his image in party political activities.

item.title: A multa contra vereador do PL que xingou Moraes, Lula e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Bahia's Electoral Court fined councilman Tenóbio (PL) R$ 30,000 for posting a video insulting authorities including Lula, Jerônimo Rodrigues, Jaques Wagner, and Alexandre de Moraes, deemed negative electoral propaganda and an attack on public institutions. Despite claiming parliamentary immunity, the fine was upheld due to recidivism and the post's wide reach on social media.

item.title: Aliado de Ciro Gomes apresenta documento nacional da federação União-PP que respalda apoio ao tucano no Ceará
item.description: The president of the União Progressista federation in Ceará, Capitão Wagner, announced that the national leadership of União Brasil and PP endorsed support for Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in the gubernatorial race, affirming the authority of the state convention in defining electoral alliances. This comes despite legal challenges by state-level party officials seeking to overturn the decision and ally with Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT), Lula’s backed candidate. The Ceará Regional Electoral Court is set to rule on the case on Thursday.

item.title: Lula sanciona criação do Pix Pensão e medidas voltadas às mulheres
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the 'Pix Pension' law, enabling automatic deduction of court-ordered child support payments, along with other measures to protect women, including publicizing the 180 hotline for domestic violence reports, regulating electronic monitoring of aggressors, and launching the Integrated Woman Safe System. The initiative aims to reduce bureaucratic burdens for single mothers and ensure consistent child support payments without repeated court involvement.

item.title: Governo Lula estuda momento ideal para mandar embaixador brasileiro voltar à Argentina
item.description: The Lula government is studying the ideal timing for the return of Brazilian ambassador Julio Bitelli to Argentina, following his recall for consultations after Argentine President Javier Milei's controversial remarks at the PL convention in São Paulo. Aides consider it unlikely he will return this week, possibly staying in Brazil for about a month, while monitoring Argentine reactions and avoiding direct confrontation, with Lula using irony and the Finance Minister calling Milei a 'clown'.

item.title: Em evento com Lula, Moraes defende que estados ajudem em pacto por mulheres
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes urged coordinated action among the three branches of government and state authorities to combat violence against women during a ceremony at the Planalto Palace alongside President Lula. He cited recent STF rulings that struck down the 'legitimate defense of honor' argument in femicide cases and praised new laws, including automatic child support enforcement ('Pix Pensão') and electronic monitoring of aggressors, as practical steps toward 'femicide zero'. Lula signed the PL 4978/2023 law establishing automatic collection of overdue child support and emphasized that efforts to end gender-based violence have moved beyond rhetoric.

item.title: Governo Lula deixará aval a embaixador dos EUA para depois da eleição
item.description: The Lula government has decided to delay granting agrément for Daniel Perez's nomination as U.S. ambassador to Brazil, postponing approval until after the second round of the 2026 elections. The delay stems from the Trump administration submitting the formal request only after publicly announcing the nomination, which deviates from standard diplomatic procedure. While not intending to reject the nomination, the Planalto plans to grant agrément only in November, leaving the U.S. embassy in Brazil under interim leadership in the meantime.

item.title: Ciro Gomes tem 50% e Elmano, 41% em eventual 2º turno no Ceará
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB) leads with 50% voting intention against 41% for Elmano de Freitas (PT) in a potential second-round runoff for governor of Ceará, according to an Ipsos-Ipec poll released July 29, 2026. The survey, registered with the TSE under BR-07235/2026, interviewed 800 people from July 23–26, with a 3-percentage-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz que Milei foi ‘educado’ e ‘suave’ nas críticas ao Brasil
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro praised Argentine President Javier Milei's criticisms of the Lula government as 'educated' and 'soft', despite Milei calling Lula a 'prisoner' and Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash'. He denied that Milei's appearance at the PL convention constituted electoral interference and accused the PT of favoring Sergio Massa in Argentina's 2023 elections. Eduardo Bolsonaro also expressed confidence in Flávio Bolsonaro's victory over Lula in 2026, citing inflation, crime, and alleged ties between Lula and organized crime.

item.title: A indústria de autodifamação do STF
item.description: Supreme Court ministers are accused of undermining the institution's authority by blaming extremist delinquency alone for its crisis, while ignoring their own ethical failures, including refusing to investigate internal misconduct and resisting a proposed ethics code. The article argues that the Court's self-inflicted reputational damage stems from within, not just external pressures.

item.title: Capitão Wagner, Cid e Luizianne lideram corrida ao Senado do Ceará
item.description: Captain Wagner leads the Senate race in Ceará with 24% voting intention, followed by Senator Cid Gomes at 22% and federal deputy Luizianne Lins at 16%, according to an Ipsos-Ipec poll released on July 29, 2026. The survey tested three scenarios, showing technical ties between Luizianne and Eunício Oliveira, and between Cid Gomes and both Wagner and Lins, within the 3-point margin of error. The poll interviewed 800 people across 39 municipalities from July 23–26, 2026, with a 95% confidence level and TSE registration BR-07235/2026.

item.title: Derrite nega desistir de disputa ao Senado em SP após liderança de Marina e Tebet em pesquisas e pressão no PP
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP) denied plans to withdraw from the Senate race in São Paulo, calling speculation about his departure a sign of opponents' desperation. He emphasized his official nomination at the party convention and claimed to lead among right-wing candidates in polls, despite Quaest and Datafolha showing Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB) ahead in the race for the two Senate seats. Internal PP pressure suggests Derrite should step aside for André do Prado (PL), seen as better connected with interior mayors, while Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) maintains a distant relationship with him.

item.title: Crise com Milei: governo ainda avalia volta de embaixador à Argentina
item.description: The Brazilian government has not set a timeline for the return of Ambassador Júlio Bitelli to Argentina, waiting for diplomatic tensions sparked by Argentine President Javier Milei's remarks against President Lula and Minister Alexandre de Moraes to subside. Bitelli was recalled to Brazil after Milei called Lula a 'prisoner' and 'thief' during the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy. Despite the insults, the Executive avoids a direct response from Lula to prevent escalation, noting that Milei's rhetoric has been poorly received publicly and may benefit Lula in the electoral context.

item.title: Lula tem 54% e venceria no 1º turno no Ceará, diz Ipsos-Ipec
item.description: Lula leads with 54% voting intention in Ceará and would win in the first round, according to an Ipsos-Ipec poll from July 2026. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) follows with 23%, while all other candidates trail below 3%. The survey of 800 respondents has a 3-point margin of error at 95% confidence.

item.title: Lula sanciona Pix Pensão e lei do 180 com Moraes no Planalto
item.description: President Lula signed into law the requirement to display the Ligue 180 hotline in public and private spaces and the 'Pix Pension' law, establishing automatic child support deductions for formal and informal workers. He also signed decrees creating the Integrated Woman Safe System and regulating Law 15.383/2026 on electronic monitoring of aggressors. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre Moraes highlighted recent STF rulings that enable urgent protective measures in areas without available judges.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula usa Super El Niño para comprar voto
item.description: The Lula government announced, through the Civil House, the early distribution of basic food baskets citing the Super El Niño climate phenomenon, aiming to expand the program's reach ahead of the October elections. The measure was disclosed by Minister Miriam Belchior in a public meeting, drawing criticism that the government is exploiting the climate crisis for electoral gain.

item.title: Defesa de Jair Bolsonaro faz movimentação natural, diz cientista político
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense described it as natural to state that he did not authorize the AI-generated video shown at the event formalizing his son Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. Political scientist Rafael Cortez assessed that the defense's reaction is expected amid rising disinformation in electoral campaigns.

item.title: Congresso do Paraguai repudia fala de Lula sobre guerra
item.description: The Paraguayan Congress unanimously approved a declaration repudiating recent remarks by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva regarding the War of the Triple Alliance, accusing him of distorting history and minimizing Paraguay’s suffering. Lawmakers also demanded the return of the El Cristiano cannon, taken by Brazil as a war trophy. The statement followed Lula’s comment in São Paulo that Paraguay invaded Brazil in 1864, which he used to justify increased defense spending.

item.title: Governo avalia que prorrogação de decreto pelos EUA sobre o Brasil pode ser preparação para novas sanções
item.description: The Brazilian government assesses that the U.S. extension of the national emergency decree against Brazil, while having no practical tariff effect after the U.S. Supreme Court ruling, may be a prelude to new sanctions, possibly under the Magnitsky Act targeting Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The move is seen as part of a U.S. political electoral strategy to intervene in Brazil’s 2026 election, favoring Flávio Bolsonaro and aligning Brazil with Trump’s interests, with Itamaraty having denied visas to U.S. officials suspected of seeking to undermine confidence in Brazil’s electoral system.

item.title: PL lança candidato indiciado pela PF por ataques a assessor de Moraes
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has nominated Ednardo Raposo as a federal deputy candidate for Rio de Janeiro, despite his indictment by the Federal Police for threats against Fabio Shor, an aide to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Raposo is accused of participating in a coordinated campaign to intimidate Shor during investigations into Jair Bolsonaro, and is barred from using social media by STF order. His candidacy registration is still under review by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Setor de infraestrutura critica Milei e diz que respeito às instituições é inegociável
item.description: Infrastructure sector representatives criticized Javier Milei's remarks during the PL convention, stating that respect for Brazilian institutions is non-negotiable and that no head of state can offend national authorities or interfere in the functioning of the Powers. The entities expressed solidarity with Brazil's republican institutions, emphasizing that political differences cannot justify violations of national sovereignty or disrespect for the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: Aliados dizem que defesa negará ciência prévia de Bolsonaro sobre vídeo
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro intends to inform the Supreme Federal Court (STF) that he had no prior knowledge of the AI-generated video shown during the PL national convention, which officially launched his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The information was shared with O Antagonista by allies connected to the campaign. The video, deemed manipulated, sparked controversy due to its use in an electoral context.

item.title: Bolsonaro diz a Moraes que não autorizou uso de imagem de IA em convenção do PL
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that it did not authorize the use of his AI-generated image in a video shown at the PL party's electoral convention last Saturday (25). The statement aims to clarify that the material, which circulated during the event, was produced without the former president's consent.

item.title: Justiça rejeita ação do PT contra Van Hattem por falas na CPI do INSS
item.description: The TJDFT dismissed a lawsuit filed by the PT against Deputy Marcel Van Hattem over statements made during the INSS CPMI, ruling they are protected by parliamentary immunity. Van Hattem linked the Lula government and the PT to pension fund embezzlement, calling them 'thieves' and accusing Lula of encouraging the scheme. The judge acknowledged the offensive nature of the remarks but held that, as political speech in the exercise of official duties, they are shielded from civil liability for moral damages.

item.title: Defesa diz que Bolsonaro não sabia de vídeo com IA e nega autorização
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro claims he had no prior knowledge or authorization for the AI-generated video featuring his image and voice, which was displayed during the PL convention supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign. Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF emphasized that any endorsement by Bolsonaro, even indirect, would violate judicial rulings barring him from political-electoral activities, potentially leading to the revocation of his house arrest.

item.title: Crusoé: Erundina disputará vaga na Alesp pelo PSOL
item.description: Luiza Erundina, former mayor of São Paulo and 91-year-old politician, has been officially named the PSOL’s pre-candidate for a seat in the São Paulo State Legislature (Alesp) in 2026. She aims to return to state politics after completing her current term in the federal Chamber of Deputies, where she co-founded the PT and began her career as a constituent state deputy in the 1980s.

item.title: ‘Bolsonaro não autorizou a utilização de sua imagem e voz’, diz defesa de ex-presidente ao STF
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro told the STF that the former president did not authorize the use of his AI-generated image and voice in a video shown at the PL convention, which urged support for his son Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. The statement responds to a query by Justice Alexandre de Moraes, who asked whether Bolsonaro had been previously consulted about the video, noting that such use could constitute a serious violation of the judicial order barring him from political activity. The defense argued that Bolsonaro, currently under a suspended visitation right, could not have authorized the video, whose dissemination may harm his son's campaign and risk revoking his house arrest.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que cria 'PIX Pensão Alimentícia', com transferências automáticas do dinheiro
item.description: President Lula signed into law the 'PIX Child Support' system, enabling automatic monthly transfers of owed support payments directly to the recipient’s bank account, with automatic debit from the payer’s account. If insufficient funds exist, the bank must notify the supervisory authority, which may freeze other financial assets of the debtor, including those of individual entrepreneurs. The law also mandates the public display of the Ligue 180 hotline for reporting violence against women in high-traffic areas and requires the CNJ to publish anonymized statistics on child support cases to enhance transparency and deter strategic non-payment.

item.title: Defesa nega que Bolsonaro tenha autorizado uso de vídeo com IA
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro denied before the STF that he authorized the use of his image and voice in an AI-generated video released at the PL convention that nominated Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate. Lawyers argued that, due to restrictions imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, Bolsonaro lacked the capacity to grant such authorization, as he is under a 30-day visitation ban and his son a 90-day ban. While denying specific authorization, the defense acknowledged that the use of Bolsonaro's public image by his children has been a continuous practice since his presidency, grounded in familial trust.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro nega a Moraes autorização de uso de imagem criada por IA
item.description: Bolsonaro’s defense told Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that he did not authorize the use of an AI-generated image of himself in the convention confirming Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. The lawyers stated that Bolsonaro neither authorized the use of his image and voice in the AI-generated video nor could he have done so, given that visits to him are suspended by Moraes’ order. Nevertheless, they acknowledged that his sons have historically used his public image without opposition, citing the natural trust between father and son and the public nature of his persona.

item.title: Bolsonaro não poderia autorizar uso de imagem e voz para vídeo gerado por IA por estar proibido de receber visitas, diz advogado
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense claims he did not authorize the AI-generated video shown at the PL convention, arguing that, due to a visitation ban imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, he could not have granted permission. The video features an AI version of Bolsonaro declaring he is 'imprisoned and silenced' and urging supporters to embrace his son, Flávio Bolsonaro, as a presidential candidate. The defense also notes that, prior to the restrictions, Bolsonaro's sons routinely used his public image in political activities without objection.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido de grupo da Espanha para observar eleições de 2026
item.description: The TSE rejected the accreditation request of the Eurolat Global Democracy Forum to observe the 2026 elections, stating the entity does not meet the technical requirements for international electoral observation missions. The decision was based on the lack of ties to recognized institutions, absence of an electoral mandate or governmental endorsement, and identification of members linked to figures critical of Brazil's electoral system, such as the former Maldives vice-president convicted of corruption.

item.title: Jerônimo chama fala de Caiado sobre baianos de "ofensiva e infeliz"
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) denounced as offensive and unfortunate remarks by presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), who said Bahians would feel 'freed' if he and ACM Neto (União Brasil) won the 2026 elections. Jerônimo emphasized that Bahia’s people are free, descended from Black and Indigenous communities, and rejected the notion that they need emancipation. He linked Caiado and ACM Neto to bolsonarismo and noted their technical tie in the Genial/Quaest poll for the state governorship.

item.title: Milei é como Nero, gosta de incendiar relações, diz analista argentino
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei was compared to Emperor Nero by an Argentine analyst for his public attacks on Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, which triggered a bilateral crisis between Brazil and Argentina. Milei’s statements, including insults and unfounded accusations, were seen as a deliberate effort to deteriorate diplomatic relations between the two nations.

item.title: Indecisão de Cleitinho e medo de governar: o que fez candidatura ao governo de Minas emperrar mesmo liderando pesquisas
item.description: Cleitinho, a senator from the Republicanos party, is facing an impasse in his pre-candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais: while his party announced his candidacy, he himself declares he will run, but electoral law prevents him from changing parties now. His hesitation stems from fear of governing a state with severe fiscal crisis and uncertainty about allies like Nikolas Ferreira.

item.title: Lula pede apoio de prefeitos para enfrentar o El Niño
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged Brazilian mayors to support federal efforts to mitigate the impacts of the El Niño phenomenon, emphasizing their local knowledge of vulnerabilities. He announced a R$1.335 billion package for prevention actions, including data unification, risk mapping, and protection of vulnerable populations, focusing on drought in the North and Northeast and floods in the South. Minister of Civil House Miriam Belchior proposed a teleconference with all 5,569 mayors to engage them in implementing the plan.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral pelo Brasil: exposição no Amazonas celebra os 30 anos da urna eletrônica
item.description: The exhibition '30 years of the Electronic Ballot: The evolution that strengthens democracy', organized by the TRE-AM at Shopping Manaus Via Norte, celebrates 30 years of Brazil's electronic voting system. The display features historical ballot box models, original documents, and photographs, allowing the public to experience the evolution of voting from canvas boxes to the current electronic system, including an interactive vote between 'Technology' and 'Nostalgia' options.

item.title: Rejeição alta, aprovação de Tarcísio e estagnação: as más notícias da Quaest para o início da campanha de Haddad
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Fernando Haddad (PT) with 58% rejection and stagnant voting intentions at 26%, while Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) rises to 41% and maintains 55% approval. Haddad’s campaign struggles with no growth despite the official start of the race, contrasting with 2022 when he led with over 40%.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Tarcísio abre 15 pontos sobre Haddad e venceria no primeiro turno
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading Fernando Haddad (PT) by 41% to 26% in the first round and 48% to 32% in the second, with 57% of valid votes projected for Tarcísio — enough to win in the first round. His approval rating stands at 55%, and 55% of voters support his re-election, indicating consolidated support and low electoral volatility.

item.title: Congresso do Paraguai repudia Lula por fala sobre a Guerra da Tríplice Aliança
item.description: The Paraguayan Congress issued a condemnation of President Lula over his remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance, accusing him of distorting and minimizing the historical conflict. The statement claims Lula’s comments disregard the severity of the war, which had devastating consequences for Paraguay.

item.title: Programa de crédito de Lula para motoristas de app não emplaca
item.description: President Lula urged faster implementation of the Move Brasil credit program, financed by BNDES, Caixa Econômica Federal, and Banco do Brasil, targeting app-based drivers, taxi drivers, and delivery workers. Despite the push, the program has failed to gain traction, facing low uptake and operational hurdles. The meeting included government ministers, highlighting the administration’s focus on the initiative.
